name: io.github.Pawansingh3889/sql-explorer-mcp
title: sql-explorer-mcp
description: Read-only SQL access for LLMs. Three engines (SQL Server, Postgres, SQLite) behind three safety layers: read-only connection, SELECT-only validation, sql-sop linting.

environmentVariables.name: SQL_EXPLORER_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the servers YAML declaring the databases to expose (default: ./servers.yaml, then ~/.sql-explorer-mcp/servers.yaml)

environmentVariables.name: SQL_EXPLORER_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a query-warden policy YAML applied before every query

environmentVariables.name: SQL_EXPLORER_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: Role to evaluate the policy as (defaults to the policy's default_role)

environmentVariables.name: SQL_EXPLORER_AUDIT_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to a tamper-evident agent-blackbox ledger; unset means no audit trail
